title: GTA 6 Leaks: Take-Two Files Secretive Discord Subpoena
description: Take-Two escalates the hunt for GTA 6 leakers by filing another secretive Discord subpoena, requesting court-sealed details on specific individuals.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Leak Investigation Escalates: Take-Two's Secretive Legal Move

As anticipation for Grand Theft Auto 6 continues to reach unprecedented heights across the gaming community, Rockstar Games parent company Take-Two is pulling no punches in its ongoing hunt for project leakers. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, the publisher has escalated its legal efforts following a series of leaks that surfaced two weeks ago, deploying a fresh and much more secretive tactic.

## Targeting Specific Individuals with Sealed Subpoenas

Reports indicate that Take-Two has filed a request for yet another subpoena regarding the leaks. However, this particular legal maneuver features a significant twist: the publisher is actively asking the court to withhold the detailed information from the public domain and keep the files sealed. By requesting a sealed document, Take-Two is evidently focusing its legal crosshairs on specific individuals, aiming to conduct the next phase of the investigation away from the public eye and media spotlight.

## Context and Industry Impact

Information security has become one of the most critical challenges for modern AAA game development. Given the immense commercial stakes surrounding GTA 6, leaks of any scale present significant risks to marketing strategies, surprise factor, and intellectual property value. Take-Two's aggressive and persistent legal pursuit underscores the industry-wide zero-tolerance approach toward unauthorized disclosures of confidential game development materials.

## Editor's Take

Take-Two's decision to seek a sealed subpoena highlights a targeted, stealthy approach to catching those responsible for the GTA 6 leaks. While legal actions of this magnitude demonstrate the fierce protectiveness of major publishers over their proprietary assets, they also illustrate the high-stakes environment of modern game development where security is constantly tested.
